votes.motion: Election of Council Member Alejandro Puy as Council Chair for Calendar Year 2026
votes.description: Council Members nominated and voted by paper ballot to elect Alejandro Puy as Council Chair for 2026. Results were confirmed by the City Attorney and City Recorder with seven votes in favor.

votes.motion: Election of Council Member Erika Carlsen as Council Vice Chair for Calendar Year 2026
votes.description: Council Members nominated and voted by paper ballot to elect Erika Carlsen as Council Vice Chair for 2026. Results were confirmed by the City Attorney and City Recorder with seven votes in favor.
